help.title: Student guidance
help.intro: Short answers for everyday Student use. This is not a legal document.
help.profile: Your Talent Profile is used to apply, match, and show eligibility. Saved values persist after reload and logout/login. Unknown legacy values stay user-correctable.
help.skills: CLAIMED is not EVIDENCE_BACKED, and EVIDENCE_BACKED is not VERIFIED. You may claim a skill and attach allowed evidence. You cannot self-verify, set a score, or award a trust badge.
help.applications: Internal Strideto employer applications are submitted on this platform. Employer workflow states (Viewed, Screening, Interview, Offer, Hired, Rejected) are read-only for you. External opportunities happen outside Strideto; your personal tracker is labelled My tracking status and is not Employer-confirmed.
help.vault: You own your Vault. Other roles only see a document after an exact grant. You can revoke grants where policy allows. There is no public document URL.
help.agents: Consultations and cases are scoped to that service. An Agent does not get your Vault or full profile unless you grant it for that exact purpose.
help.notifications: In-app notifications are the launch channel. Security and trust notices cannot be turned off. Email, SMS, and push are shown only if configured.
help.privacy: Consent is per purpose: employer application, Agent consultation, Agent case, institution application, and Vault grant. There is no blanket “share with partners” switch.
help.export: You can request a data export or account deletion. Deletion is a request, not an immediate erase. Required audit and financial records are retained.
help.payments: Agent services may be free, payment required, or not configured. Paid is never faked. Card numbers are never collected on this page.

messages.title: Messages
messages.intro: Messaging is contextual. There is no global inbox for arbitrary DMs.

privacy.title: Privacy and data sharing
privacy.intro: See what is shared, with whom, and how to request export or deletion.
privacy.scopesBody: Employer applications, Agent consultations, Agent cases, institution applications, and Vault grants are separate. None of them is a blanket partner-share.
privacy.deletionWarning: This requests account deletion. It does not delete immediately. Audit, financial, and legally required records are retained. You can cancel while the request is still in requested status.
privacy.confirmDeletion: I understand this is a request, not an immediate delete
privacy.noArtifact: No downloadable archive is available yet.
privacy.noRequests: No export or deletion requests yet.
privacy.channelOff: {{channel}} is not configured on this environment.
privacy.mandatoryNote: Security, verification, and trust notices cannot be turned off.
